_help: Your search settings. Claude fills this in during setup; you can also edit it by hand.
email_addresses: every email you apply from. The weekly finder searches all of them. The first one is the default portal email.
categories: the buckets every posting gets sorted into (short names, for example Software, Data, Consulting). Use 3 to 8.
rank1_cities: cities you most want (lowercase is fine). A posting in any of these ranks 1.
rank2_states: two-letter state codes that are good but not top choice. A posting there ranks 2.
remote_is_rank2: true means Remote (US) postings rank 2. Everything else ranks 3.
After editing, restart the app: ~/InternshipHunt/bin/ih restart
